facts.fact: Mustaqbal Media reports the Somali Police spokesperson saying a collaborative system will unite 20 police stations in the Banaadir region with the CID, judiciary and prosecution, with training begun and operations expected in the first six months of 2026.
facts.system: Somali Police integrated crime coordination system

systems.system: Somali Police integrated crime coordination system

SOM.note: The system is not yet operating; the source does not say stations record reports in it, and the assisting government is unnamed.
